<ul class="digest-points">

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative and judicial developments:</strong> Parliament has passed the Transgender Persons Amendment Bill, 2026, and the Supreme Court has scrapped all FIRs against NEET protesters, providing significant relief to the student community.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Constitutional and administrative disputes:</strong> The Punjab government has informed the Supreme Court that meeting ₹14,000-crore in DA dues within 14 days is constitutionally impossible, underscoring fiscal challenges facing state administrations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
